cases.name: Marlina Medrano
cases.about: She was a nurse. Her friend said she was the type of person who would drop everything to help someone if they were in need & had the most beautiful smile they'd ever seen. On Thursday, Medrano shared a quote on Facebook. In many ways, her friends say it epitomized who she was. "Always leave people better than you found them."
